summary: Iteration 3 verified the new admin panel + hero carousel + marquee + festive collection features end-to-end (backend + frontend UI). Backend: admin login (hello@sojaru.co.in / Sojaru@123) returns is_admin=true; customer login returns is_admin=false; non-admin PUT /api/admin/settings correctly returns 403; POST /api/admin/hero-images uploads and object-storage-serves via /api/media/{path}; DELETE removes the image; GET /api/settings reflects hero_images, marquee_texts, festive; category 33 has products. Frontend: /admin without a token redirects to /admin/login; wrong password stays on login; a non-admin JWT does not reach /admin; admin login redirects to /admin dashboard ('Welcome back, admin!'). Hero tab uploads 2 tiny PNGs (0/5 counter present) — homepage then shows a 2-dot auto-sliding carousel; the 'Free shipping over ₹1,499' and 'Sustainably made' texts are GONE from the hero (marquee band still shows them, per design). Moving Text tab shows 5 marquee inputs prefilled with saved values. Festive tab shows editable title (default 'Festive Collection'), category select, and enabled toggle; homepage renders bordered 'FESTIVE COLLECTION' card below hero with products from category 33. Cleanup performed: both uploaded hero images deleted, marquee_texts and festive left at defaults.

minor.issue: Response user object does not include is_admin field (returns undefined/null). POST /api/auth/login correctly returns is_admin: false/true. Recommend adding "is_admin": bool(user.get("is_admin")) to the register response for symmetry.

issues: Only tiny 1x1 PNGs uploaded during testing — real 5MB hero images should be verified for object-fit/cropping on wide viewports. Not a blocker.
